[Trend Position]
· Current Price($122.29) vs SMA5/20/50($124.52/$129.01/$130.70) — Below short-term MAs, below mid-term MAs
· vs SMA100/200($137.12/$152.89) — Below long-term MAs, confirming weak trend
· 52-week Position(15.7%) + Current price range near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (42.4→43.4) — Attempting to exit oversold, weak recovery confirmed
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (hist -0.7412→-0.7412) — Weakness persists, no trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower $119.61) — Approaching lower band, narrowing band width
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($125.25) — Based on 5-day high and pivot

Decreased confidence due to low trading volume
